Trusted Emergency HVAC & Plumbing Company in Paramus, NJ


From emergency plumbing repairs to HVAC maintenance tune-ups and system upgrades, Arctic Plumbing & HVAC delivers fast, dependable air conditioning repair and furnace maintenance across Bergen, Passaic, Essex, Hudson, and Morris counties. Our local HVAC contractors are ready 24/7—no extra fees, just emergency AC services and plumbing solutions you can trust. Call now for same-day comfort!

Book Online 
(973) 557-6742
Full-Service HVAC and Plumbing Solutions in North Jersey


At Arctic Plumbing & HVAC, we understand that heating, cooling, and plumbing issues can’t wait—especially during extreme weather or sudden emergencies. That’s why we provide dependable HVAC service and maintenance, emergency AC services, and same-day plumbing solutions throughout Paramus, NJ, and nearby areas like Woodcliff Lake, Oradell, Westwood, and Alpine. Whether it’s a mid-summer AC breakdown, a sudden leak, or an outdated furnace on a freezing morning, you need expert help that arrives fast and gets it right the first time.﻿

Leaky faucet or new pipes? We handle plumbing repair with speed and care.

Meet Arctic Plumbing & HVAC
Our Story

Arctic Plumbing & HVAC began with a simple mission: to provide the residents of Northern New Jersey with honest and reliable mechanical services. We understood that homeowners needed a contractor they could trust in their homes—someone who would treat their property with respect and provide solutions that lasted. Through years of hard work and a commitment to customer satisfaction, we have grown into a leading provider of HVAC and plumbing solutions. Our team consists of local experts who take pride in their craft and their community. We continue to invest in training and technology to ensure that the Arctic name remains synonymous with quality.

Contact Us
Why Trust Us for Heating Maintenance & More?


When it comes to plumbing repair or AC installation, Arctic Plumbing & HVAC is the easy choice for North Jersey homeowners. Our 24/7 emergency plumbing service means no extra fees for late-night leaks, and our same-day service gets your air conditioning repair or heating maintenance done fast. With over 150 years of combined experience, our crew knows how to handle everything from furnace repair to tricky boiler replacement jobs with care and skill.




Based in North Jersey, we’re not just fixing pipes and systems—we’re building trust. Serving Bergen, Passaic, Essex, Hudson, and Morris counties, Arctic Plumbing & HVAC brings peace of mind with every visit. You’ll love our friendly team, quick fixes, and the way we go the extra mile to keep your home running smoothly all year long.﻿

VISION

We dream of a North Jersey where every home enjoys flawless HVAC service and plumbing repair. Arctic Plumbing & HVAC aims to lead the way with fast, affordable AC installation and heating maintenance for all!

MISSION

Our mission is simple: deliver unbeatable same-day service and emergency plumbing help whenever you call. Arctic Plumbing & HVAC is here to make furnace repair and boiler replacement hassle-free for every customer.
